title: The combination of puerarin and simvastatin alleviates inflammatory responses and promotes osteogenic differentiation via an IRF4-mediated mechanism in periodontal ligament stem cells.
authors: Lu, Zhenfei; Lu, Jin; Zeng, Bin; Chen, Liangjian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葛根素与辛伐他汀通过IRF4机制减轻牙周膜干细胞炎症并促进成骨分化，虽涉及分子对接但核心为细胞实验与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The impaired function of periodontal ligament stem cells (PDLSCs) impedes the restoration of periodontal tissues. Puerarin (Pue) is a natural flavonoid component derived from Pueraria lobata, and simvastatin (Sim) is a lactone-form statin. Both have been shown to promote proliferation and osteogenic differentiation and to exert anti-inflammatory effects in human PDLSCs. This study aimed to elucidate the effects of Pue and Sim in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated PDLSCs and the underlying mechanism. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Bioinformatics, weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA), machine learning, and molecular docking were used to identify genes associated with periodontitis in the GSE10334 dataset. LPS was administered to simulate an inflammatory microenvironment in PDLSCs. IRF4 protein expression was assessed by western blotting. The mRNA levels of IRF4, RGS1, CD27, CXCR4, Runx2, ALP, and OCN were measured using quantitative real-time PCR. Cell viability was assessed using a Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) assay. The levels of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), malondialdehyde (MDA), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and interleukin-6 (IL-6) were measured using commercial kits or ELISA. Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) and Alizarin Red (AR) staining were performed to assess osteogenic differentiation. RESULTS: Diminished secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines, reduced production of MDA and LDH, augmented ALP activity and calcium deposition, and elevated expression of osteogenic differentiation-related genes were observed in the Pue + Sim group compared with the Pue group, Sim group, and control group in LPS-treated PDLSCs. Bioinformatics, WGCNA, machine learning, and molecular docking identified IRF4 as a key gene associated with Pue and Sim treatment. The expression of IRF4 was significantly diminished following treatment with Pue, Sim, or Pue + Sim. The protective effect of Pue + Sim treatment was attenuated by IRF4 overexpression. CONCLUSIONS: The combination of Pue and Sim treatment showed strong effects in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress and promoting osteogenic differentiation via an IRF4-mediated mechanism in LPS-stimulated PDLSCs, providing a promising therapeutic strategy for treating periodontitis.
abstract_zh: 背景：牙周膜干细胞（PDLSCs）功能受损阻碍牙周组织修复。葛根素（Pue）是从葛根中提取的天然黄酮类成分，辛伐他汀（Sim）是一种内酯型他汀类药物。两者均已被证明能促进人PDLSCs的增殖和成骨分化，并发挥抗炎作用。本研究旨在阐明Pue和Sim在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的PDLSCs中的作用及其潜在机制。材料与方法：利用生物信息学、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）、机器学习和分子对接，在GSE10334数据集中识别与牙周炎相关的基因。使用LPS模拟PDLSCs中的炎症微环境。通过蛋白质印迹法评估IRF4蛋白表达。使用定量实时PCR测量IRF4、RGS1、CD27、CXCR4、Runx2、ALP和OCN的mRNA水平。使用细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）法评估细胞活力。使用商业试剂盒或ELISA测量乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、丙二醛（MDA）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）的水平。进行碱性磷酸酶（ALP）和茜素红（AR）染色以评估成骨分化。结果：在LPS处理的PDLSCs中，与Pue组、Sim组和对照组相比，Pue + Sim组观察到促炎细胞因子分泌减少、MDA和LDH产生降低、ALP活性和钙沉积增强，以及成骨分化相关基因表达升高。生物信息学、WGCNA、机器学习和分子对接将IRF4确定为与Pue和Sim治疗相关的关键基因。Pue、Sim或Pue + Sim处理后，IRF4表达显著降低。IRF4过表达减弱了Pue + Sim处理的保护作用。结论：Pue和Sim联合治疗在LPS刺激的PDLSCs中通过IRF4介导的机制显示出减少炎症和氧化应激及促进成骨分化的强效作用，为治疗牙周炎提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。
